analysis.summary: Users must be able to log in to SauceDemo with valid credentials and reach the inventory page; invalid credentials or empty username/password must be rejected with an error message and remain on the login page.

explicit_requirements.statement: Users must be able to log in to SauceDemo using valid credentials and reach the inventory page.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Users must be able to log in to SauceDemo using valid credentials and reach the inventory page.

explicit_requirements.statement: Invalid credentials and empty submissions must be rejected.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Invalid credentials and empty submissions must be rejected.

explicit_requirements.statement: Given standard_user / secret_sauce, the user is taken to the inventory page.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Given standard_user / secret_sauce, the user is taken to the inventory page.

explicit_requirements.statement: Given invalid credentials, an error message is displayed and the user stays on the login page.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Given invalid credentials, an error message is displayed and the user stays on the login page.

explicit_requirements.statement: Given empty username or password, an error message is displayed.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Given empty username or password, an error message is displayed.

scenarios.title: Successful login with standard_user credentials navigates to inventory page
Login attempt with invalid credentials shows error and remains on login page
Login attempt with empty username shows error message
Login attempt with empty password shows error message

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Login with other valid user accounts
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: Requirement mentions "valid credentials" but only specifies standard_user/secret_sauce

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Login with whitespace-only username or password
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: Edge case for empty submissions not explicitly defined

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Case sensitivity of username/password
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: Not specified whether credentials are case‑sensitive

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Multiple consecutive failed login attempts
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: Potential lockout or throttling behavior not described

missing_information: Exact list of valid user credentials beyond the example
Exact text of the error messages to be displayed
Behavior when both username and password are empty versus only one field empty
UI element identifiers for username, password, login button, and error message container
ambiguities: Definition of "invalid credentials" (wrong password, wrong username, both?)
Whether "empty submissions" refers to one empty field, both empty, or whitespace-only input
analysis.validation_notes: All explicit statements from the user text have been captured as requirements; derived scenarios follow directly from those requirements. Missing details and ambiguities are noted.
